ambiguities.description: The deal says 'attendance > 550' but does not specify whether attendance is measured by tickets scanned, tickets sold, or paid attendance net of comps. On a show near the threshold this could swing the bonus.

plausibleReadings.summary: Attendance = paid tickets sold (presale + day-of), regardless of whether holders actually entered
plausibleReadings.impact: Artist-favorable in sell-ahead scenarios; could trigger bonus even with walk-ups no-shows.

plausibleReadings.summary: Attendance = bodies scanned at door, net of complimentary admissions
plausibleReadings.impact: Venue-favorable; no-shows and comps could keep the count under 550 and forfeit the $500 bonus.

ambiguities.suggestedClarification: For the attendance bonus: is the 550 threshold measured by tickets sold, tickets scanned at the door, or paid attendance net of comps? And are guest-list comps counted toward or excluded from that number?

ambiguities.clauseRef: Hospitality cap $400 — relationship to expense cap $1,800
ambiguities.description: The deal lists a separate hospitality cap of $400 but the expense cap of $1,800 covers 'production, sound, lights only.' It is unambiguous that hospitality is outside the $1,800 cap, but it is not stated whether the $400 hospitality spend also reduces net before the 85% is applied or is handled as a separate line.

plausibleReadings.summary: Hospitality is deducted from gross alongside the capped expenses before the 85% net calculation
plausibleReadings.impact: Venue-favorable by up to $340 (85% of $400) on the artist's percentage side.

plausibleReadings.summary: Hospitality is a separate settled line and does not affect the net figure used for the percentage calculation
plausibleReadings.impact: Artist-favorable; the percentage base is not reduced by hospitality costs.

ambiguities.suggestedClarification: Is the $400 hospitality allowance deducted from gross when calculating net for the 85% split, or is it settled as a separate line item outside the percentage calculation?

sourceText: $3,500 guarantee vs 85% of net after capped expenses (whichever is greater). Expense cap $1,800 covering production, sound, lights only. Hospitality cap $400. +$500 if attendance > 550.
